reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

That ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88 has actually reached your Access Bank account (0234567891). When we checked directly with your bank for the final status, it confirms the amount was credited on 21 November 2026. The "failed" flag on our system was just an internal error and does not reflect the real outcome — the money went through.

For that reason we have not resent it, to avoid paying you twice. Could you please check your account statement for the incoming transfer of ₦250,000 on 21 November? If after checking you still don't see it, get in touch and we'll investigate further, but it's already in your account.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen
